title: Gloves of Crushing

sources.title: Crushing Blows
markers: | description = The wearer gains a +1 bonus to unarmed {{Attack Roll}}s and their unarmed attacks deal an additional {{DamageText|2|Bludgeoning}} damage.

summary: Improves unarmed attacks. The pinned source reports the attack roll bonus applies twice.

fields.Base value: 160 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Crushing Blows: Unarmed hits deal 2 extra Bludgeoning. The tooltip shows +1 to attack rolls, but the pinned source reports that bonus applies twice. The attack roll bonus also applies to Throws, which do not gain the extra damage.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
